## Engineering services
- https://laxitech.com/services/software-engineering — Web, mobile, desktop and backend engineering.

- https://laxitech.com/services/infrastructure — Servers, networking, virtualization and operations.
- https://laxitech.com/services/devops-automation — CI/CD, infrastructure as code and delivery automation.
- https://laxitech.com/services/ai-automation — AI integrations and business workflow automation.
- https://laxitech.com/services/security-engineering — Application security, access control and backend hardening.

## Products
- https://laxitech.com/products/vps — Pakistan-hosted NVMe VPS. Starter: PKR 999/month, 1 core, 2 GB RAM, 30 GB NVMe, 1 TB bandwidth. Business: PKR 1,799/month, 2 cores, 4 GB RAM, 60 GB NVMe, 2 TB bandwidth. Pro: PKR 3,299/month, 4 cores, 8 GB RAM, 120 GB NVMe, 4 TB bandwidth.
- https://laxitech.com/products/gxmail — GXMail custom-domain email with secure SMTP/IMAP, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, webmail, shared storage and SMTP credentials. Starter: PKR 250/month or 3,000/year, 1 domain, 15 mailboxes and 30 GB. Business: PKR 333/month or 3,999/year, 3 domains, 20 mailboxes and 60 GB. Business Pro: PKR 500/month or 5,999/year, 5 domains, no mailbox-count limit and 200 GB shared storage.
- https://laxitech.com/products/gxnotify — GXNotify sends email, SMS and FCM push notifications through one API using the customer's own SMTP, SMS gateway and Firebase project, with templates, subscribers, retries, webhooks and delivery history. Starter: PKR 500/month, 1 project, 200 email, 100 push, 50 SMS, 10 API keys, 5 templates. Business: PKR 1,999/month, 10 projects, 100,000 email, 10,000 push, 500 SMS, 20 API keys, 50 templates. Business Pro: PKR 3,999/month, 50 projects, 300,000 email, 30,000 push, 1,000 SMS, 30 API keys, 200 templates.
